name: Inter-Caste / Inter-Religious Marriage Award
benefit: The married couple is jointly provided with a financial amount of ₹50,000/-.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must a married couple who has entered into either an inter-caste or an inter-religious marriage. 1. In the case of an inter-caste marriage, one spouse must belong to a Scheduled Caste. 1. In the case of an inter-religious marriage, both spouses must belong to different religions.
